decisions.reason: As a reissued jazz vinyl LP it fits the firm's reissue capabilities, collector audience, and genre-broadening path, so it is likely near aspiration levels and worth retaining under normal slack.
A multi-disc box set is costly and niche but matches the firm's curated collector-oriented offer, so unless performance clearly falls below aspiration the firm would keep it while monitoring results.

A compilation music CD looks less differentiated and closer to the already abandoned CD-style experiments, so expected results are more likely to fall below aspiration and the resources are better shifted to stronger core or new projects.
